primary_metric: mean average precision across validation conditions clean, mcar_0.2, mcar_0.4, mar_anchor_x0; separately report shifted-only mean over mcar_0.4 and mar_anchor_x0
choice_rule: Candidate is anchor_full with fixed estimator/remasking settings. Strongest control is selected as the maximum three-seed mean_ap_all among uniform_augmentation, native_nan_duplicate, and impute_indicators; no candidate parameters are selected or tuned from validation labels.
phase_one_boundary: Validation only. MNAR and reversed MNAR are absent from the validation fixture, so this phase cannot establish the proposal’s defining shortcut-sign-reversal claim. Final fixture mode has not been called.
